verdict.rationale: Inspecting why a result ranked where it did is a fair question for a search engine, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents the built-in ranking rules and how to reorder them. It shows no per-result ranking score, score breakdown, or explanation output a platform engineer could inspect. Documentation of ranking rules is an adjacent feature, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can inspect ranking scores or explanations to understand exactly why a result ranked where it did
